why.quote: Note: Students who take PHYSICS 5A to satisfy the Physics A requirement must take PHYSICS 5B and PHYSICS 5BL to complete the Physics B requirement.
why.reasoning: The catalog splits Physics B into 'Option 1 (Only for students who completed PHYSICS 7A)' and 'Option 2 (Only for students who completed PHYSICS 5A)' but emits both as required rules, so nobody could satisfy both. The two options are really two sequences: 7A+7B or 5A+5B+5BL. The department's flowcharts (https://aero.berkeley.edu/curriculum-flowchart-class-of-2027-and-beyond-2/) show only PHYS 7A and 7B, but they don't rule out the 5 series, so the catalog's 5-series path is kept. This one rule replaces Physics A and both Physics B rules.

rule.name: Technical Electives (two courses from each of two areas)

why.quote: Students must take four elective courses from two of the areas listed below:
why.reasoning: The catalog placeholder says 'Four courses are required from two different areas: Two courses from one area, and two courses from another area.', but the catalog then emits all 17 areas as separate required 'at least 2' rules, which would require 34 courses. Encoded as two of the area sub-rules, each needing two courses. Area lists follow the department's Technical Electives page, which adds MECENG 144 (catalog code MECENG C144/AEROENG C144; Computational Tools) and AEROENG 122 (Space Technologies), and fills the catalog's empty Fluid Mechanics area with 'Fluid Mechanics: AEROENG C166/MECENG C166,'. Air Transportation/Aviation was 'allOf' of its two courses, which is the same as at least 2. Fluid Mechanics has only one listed course, so as an area it can't currently supply two courses; it's kept for completeness. The department also lists CIVENG 190 (topic-specific, under Humans and Automation and Power) and MECENG 193B (topic 'Feedback Control of Legged Robots', under Control/AI and Dynamical Systems). These aren't encoded because GradTrak can't check special-topic titles. The department also lists AEROENG 143 under Propulsion, but that course isn't in the 2026-27 catalog, so it's left out.
